hook: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the slow 5%.
hookText: Port only the hot 5% to Rust

beats.say: fast-anything profiles a Python, Node or Ruby app and ranks its functions by time and how portable they are.
It records up to 500 real calls, has your coding agent port just that function to Rust, and replays every call to prove the results match.
Then it swaps the Rust version in with one command, fully reversible, and benchmarks the whole app before and after.
